name: Tongkat Ali
summary: Tongkat ali (Eurycoma longifolia) is a Southeast Asian root and TikTok's favorite 'natural testosterone' herb. A 2022 meta-analysis of 5 RCTs found increased total testosterone (SMD 1.352, p=0.001) with high heterogeneity (PMID 36013514), concentrated in men starting low; a 2024 trial in trained adults found no effect on free testosterone. EFSA (2021) concluded safety is 'not established' over genotoxicity signals.
description: Canonical tongkat ali research entity for evidence and safety integration. Publication remains held until the EFSA safety-not-established flag is prominently documented, hypogonadal vs eugonadal evidence boundaries are explicit, and total-vs-free testosterone distinctions have passed the site's review gates.
primary_effects_or_targets: androgen signaling; total testosterone; erectile function
